words: cramped
/kræmpt/ adj.. 狭窄的；拥挤的（形容空间狭小而拥挤，通常指房间、车厢等地方）

sleeper

inevitably
/ɪnˈevɪtəbli/ adv.. 不可避免地；必然地（修饰动词，表示某事必然会发生）
motorway

ferry

intimidate

escapist

uncrumpled
/ʌnˈkrʌmpəld/ adj.. 未弄皱的；精神饱满的（指人到达目的地后依然精神焕发、精力充沛）
phrases: take your mind off
转移注意力；使不再想某事
Reading is only a partial solution, for the monotonous rhythm of the wheels clicking on the rails soon lull you to sleep.
阅读只是部分解决办法，因为车轮撞击铁轨的单调节奏很快就会让你昏昏欲睡。
He tried to take his mind off the problem by watching TV.
他试图通过看电视来转移注意力，不再想那个问题。
come in snatches
断断续续地；时有时无地
During the day, sleep comes in snatches.
白天的时候，睡眠断断续续。
We only got the information in snatches.
我们只是断断续续地得到这些信息。
by comparison
相比之下；比较起来
By comparison, ferry trips or cruises offer a great variety of civilized comforts.
相比之下，渡船旅行或游轮提供了多种多样的文明享受。
By comparison, city life is more exciting.
相比之下，城市生活更加精彩。
stretch your legs
伸展双腿；走动活动
You can stretch your legs on the spacious decks, play games, meet interesting people and enjoy good food.
你可以在宽敞的甲板上伸展双腿、做游戏、结识有趣的人、享用美食。
We've been driving for hours. Let's stop and stretch our legs.
我们已经开了几个小时的车了，停下来活动一下吧。
have the reputation of
有...的名声/声誉
Aeroplanes have the reputation of being dangerous and even hardened travellers are intimidated by them.
飞机有危险的名声，甚至老练的旅行者也对其感到畏惧。
She has the reputation of being very reliable.
她有非常可靠的名声。
settle back
放松地坐好；靠回椅背
For a few hours, you settle back in a deep armchair to enjoy the flight.
在几个小时内，你可以靠在扶手椅上享受飞行。
Settle back and enjoy the show.
坐好享受演出吧。
prevent sb. from doing sth.
阻止某人做某事
The journey is so smooth that there is nothing to prevent you from reading or sleeping.
旅途如此平稳，没有什么能阻止你阅读或睡觉。
Nothing can prevent me from achieving my goals.
没有什么能阻止我实现目标。
more often than not
经常；多半
but more often than not, the greater part of the journey is spent on roads with few service stations and too much traffic.
但更多的时候，大部分旅程是在只有很少服务站和交通拥挤的道路上度过的。
More often than not, she arrives late for meetings.
她开会经常迟到。
always assuming that
假设；只要是
enjoy good food--always assuming, of course, that the sea is calm.
享用美食——当然，前提是海面平静。
I'll help you, always assuming that you need my assistance.
我会帮你的，只要你需要我的帮助。
get sb. to somewhere
把某人送到某地
An aeroplane gets you to your destination rapidly.
飞机会快速把你送到目的地。
The bus will get you to the station on time.
公共汽车会把你准时送到车站。

grammar.k: 否定副词开头的倒装句 (Inversion with Negative Adverbs)
grammar.f: 否定词 + 助动词/be动词 + 主语 + 动词原形...
grammar.d: 当否定副词或否定意义的词组位于句首时，句子需要使用部分倒装语序，即把助动词或be动词提到主语前面。 用于强调否定意义，常见的否定词包括：hardly, never, rarely, seldom, not until, no sooner, little等。
ex: Hardly anyone can positively enjoy sitting in a train for more than a few hours.
几乎没有人能够真正享受连续坐几个小时的火车。
Rarely do we see such a beautiful sunset.
我们很少见到如此美丽的日落。
Never have I seen such a magnificent building.
我从未见过如此雄伟的建筑。

grammar.f: It + be + 形容词 + (for/of sb.) + to do sth.
grammar.d: 用it作形式主语，而把真正的主语（通常是不定式、动名词或从句）放在句子后面，使句子更加平衡。 当主语较长时，为了避免句子头重脚轻，使用形式主语it。
ex: It is almost impossible to take your mind off the journey.
几乎不可能使自己不想到旅途。
It is difficult to learn a new language.
学习一门新语言是很难的。
It is necessary for us to practice every day.
我们每天练习是必要的。

grammar.f: If + 主语 + 动词..., 主语 + 动词/情态动词...
grammar.d: 用于表达假设或条件的主从复合句，包括真实条件和虚拟条件。 if引导的条件句可以表示真实条件或非真实（假设）的条件。
ex: If you are lucky enough to get a sleeper, you spend half the night staring at the small blue light.
如果你足够幸运得到了卧铺，你会花半天时间盯着天花板上蓝色的小灯。
If it is not, and you are likely to get seasick, no form of transport could be worse.
如果海不平静，你可能会晕船，那么没有任何交通工具会比这更糟糕了。

patterns.p: Hardly anyone can + 动词原形...
o: Hardly anyone can positively enjoy sitting in a train for more than a few hours.
几乎没有人能够真正享受连续坐几个小时的火车。
im: Hardly anyone can resist the temptation of free food.
几乎没有人能抵制免费食物的诱惑。
Hardly anyone can understand his complicated theory.
几乎没有人能理解他那套复杂的理论。

patterns.p: It is + 形容词 + to do sth.
o: It is almost impossible to take your mind off the journey.
几乎不可能使自己不想到旅途。
im: It is difficult to make a decision without all the facts.
没有全部事实很难做决定。
It is necessary to arrive early for the interview.
提前到达面试是必要的。

o: By comparison, ferry trips or cruises offer a great variety of civilized comforts.
相比之下，渡船旅行或游轮提供了多种多样的文明享受。
im: By comparison, living in the countryside is much quieter.
相比之下，住在乡下要安静得多。
By comparison, this restaurant offers better value for money.
相比之下，这家餐厅的性价比更高。

o: But nothing can match them for speed and comfort.
但就速度和舒适度而言，没有任何交通工具能比得上它们。
im: Nothing can replace the warmth of a mother's love.
没有什么能取代母爱的温暖。
Nothing can prevent him from reaching his goals.
没有什么能阻止他实现目标。
